excerpt.zh: [current_uprising_originator.GetName]陷入了内战，有机体领导的[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]政府和那些迁徙至他们数个星系的智慧机器人兵戎相见，这些机器人被称为[current_uprising.GetName]。
excerpt.en: The [current_uprising_originator.GetName] is embroiled in civil war, pitting the organic [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] government against the intelligence that metastasized in their systems, known as the [current_uprising.GetName].
